Swiss Interior Design
Advertiser: Swiss Interior
Started: 24 Mar 2026
Home isn't just four walls. It's the morning light that falls
just right, the corner that tells a story, the detail that
only you would notice. ✨ The team at Swiss Interior had the
privilege of transforming Yvonne Lim's home. And today, she's
opening the doors to show you the result. Every room, every
finish, every design choice was born from a deep desire to
create something truly extraordinary. From the moment you step
through the front door, you feel it. A space so thoughtfully
crafted, so full of soul, that it takes your breath away. This
